d: Today's episode unveils a hidden gem from the quaint town of Runi Saidpur in Bihar – Balushahi. Unlike its more well-known North Indian counterpart, this beloved delicacy is a soft, sugar syrup-laden ball crafted from fresh cottage cheese. For Anubhav, who fondly reminisces about indulging in this juicy treat during his childhood, Balushahi holds a special place as a cherished piece of nostalgia.
